1. (1) This Act may be called the Balochistan University of Information Technology, Engineering and Management Sciences (Amendment) Act, 2015.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
12. After section 18 of the Ordinance No. XI of
2002), the following new provisions shall be inserted and shall have effect from the appointed day.
18. (1) The Senate shall consist of the Chancellor, the Vice Chancellor and the members named in this section.
(2) A member of the Senate other than an ex-officio member shall hold office for three years.
10. The quorum for a meeting of the Senate shall be one-half of its membership.
18-B. Power and functions of the Senate.
(1) The Senate shall be the supreme body of the University and shall exercise the powers assigned to it by this Act.
